SELECT s.loser_id AS team_id, t.CITY, t.NICKNAME, s.winner_id AS swept_by_team_id, w.CITY AS winner_city, w.NICKNAME AS winner_nickname
FROM (
  SELECT winner_id, loser_id, COUNT(*) AS series_wins
  FROM (
    SELECT games_game_id,
           CASE WHEN home_team_wins = 1 THEN home_team_id ELSE visitor_team_id END AS winner_id,
           CASE WHEN home_team_wins = 1 THEN visitor_team_id ELSE home_team_id END AS loser_id
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT games_game_id, home_team_id, visitor_team_id, home_team_wins
      FROM enterprise_dw.TRANSFORMED.src_games
      WHERE season = 2017 AND games_game_id // 100000 = 417
    ) g
  ) r
  GROUP BY winner_id, loser_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 4
) s
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         CASE WHEN home_team_wins = 1 THEN home_team_id ELSE visitor_team_id END AS winner_id,
         CASE WHEN home_team_wins = 1 THEN visitor_team_id ELSE home_team_id END AS loser_id
  FROM enterprise_dw.TRANSFORMED.src_games
  WHERE season = 2017 AND games_game_id // 100000 = 417
) rev ON rev.winner_id = s.loser_id AND rev.loser_id = s.winner_id
LEFT JOIN enterprise_dw.RAW.raw_teams t ON t.TEAM_ID = s.loser_id
LEFT JOIN enterprise_dw.RAW.raw_teams w ON w.TEAM_ID = s.winner_id
WHERE rev.winner_id IS NULL

answer.sql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT games_game_id, game_date_est, home_team_id, visitor_team_id, home_team_wins
  FROM enterprise_dw.TRANSFORMED.src_games
  WHERE season = 2012
    AND CAST(games_game_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE '2%'
),
t AS (
  SELECT games_game_id, game_date_est, home_team_id AS team_id, CASE WHEN home_team_wins = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS won
  FROM g
  UNION ALL
  SELECT games_game_id, game_date_est, visitor_team_id AS team_id, CASE WHEN home_team_wins = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS won
  FROM g
),
r AS (
  SELECT team_id, games_game_id, game_date_est, won,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_id ORDER BY game_date_est, games_game_id)
         - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_id, won ORDER BY game_date_est, games_game_id) AS grp
  FROM t
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT team_id, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_length, MIN(game_date_est) AS streak_start, MAX(game_date_est) AS streak_end
  FROM r
  WHERE won = 1
  GROUP BY team_id, grp
)
SELECT team_id, streak_length, streak_start, streak_end
FROM streaks
WHERE streak_length = (SELECT MAX(streak_length) FROM streaks)
ORDER BY team_id
LIMIT 501
